description: Company index page at /companies and company detail page at /company/[slug] with full company-scoped views: jobs list, skills breakdown, phrases, gap analysis, company-scoped resume builder (using company intelligence in LLM context), resume/cover letter drafts, application tracking, and networking placeholder.
steps: Create src/app/companies/page.tsx - Companies index page listing all companies as cards. Show: company name, job count, dream company badge (star icon), last job added date. Include search/filter, link to add company. Cards link to /company/[slug]. Add a 'Sync Companies from Jobs' button that calls POST /api/companies/sync. Visual style matches existing pages (bg-gray-50, white cards, purple-600 primary).

Create src/app/company/[slug]/page.tsx - Company detail page. This is the main company hub. Fetch company data from GET /api/companies/[slug]. Layout: header with company name, dream company toggle (star), intelligence notes editor (textarea that auto-saves via PATCH). Below header, tabbed interface with tabs: Jobs, Skills, Phrases, Resume Builder, Drafts, Applications, Networking.
Implement the Jobs tab: list all jobs for this company (fetched with company data). Show job cards with status, dream job toggle, skills. Allow status changes inline.
Implement the Skills tab: aggregate all skills from this company's jobs, show them grouped by category with frequency counts. Similar to the main skills page but scoped to this company.
Implement the Phrases tab: show all responsibilities/phrases from this company's jobs, grouped by keyword. Similar to /phrases but scoped.

Implement the Resume Builder tab: two modes - (1) Targeted: select a specific job from this company and generate a resume for it, (2) Generic: generate a company-scoped generic resume optimized for all jobs at this company. Both modes include company intelligence in the LLM prompt context. Call the existing /api/resume/generate endpoint with an added companySlug or companyId parameter.

Create src/app/api/resume/generate-company/route.ts - A company-scoped resume generation endpoint that wraps the existing logic but: only considers jobs from the specified company, injects the company's intelligence/notes into the system prompt as additional context about the company, supports both targeted (single job) and generic (all company jobs) modes.
Implement the Drafts tab: list all ResumeProject records associated with this company's jobs. Show status, creation date, link to view/continue in the wizard.
Implement the Applications tab: show this company's jobs filtered by application statuses (applied, interviewing, offer, rejected). Timeline-like view showing status progression.
Implement the Networking tab: placeholder with a message like 'Networking features coming soon - track contacts and outreach for this company.' Style it nicely with an icon.
Add Companies link to the main dashboard navigation (src/app/page.tsx header nav) and add a Companies card to the Features section.
acceptance_criteria: /companies page lists all companies with job counts and dream company badges
/company/[slug] page shows company detail with tabbed interface
Company intelligence field is editable and auto-saves
Dream company toggle works on company detail page
Jobs tab shows company's jobs with status management
Skills tab shows aggregated skills from company's jobs
Resume Builder tab generates company-scoped resumes with intelligence in context
Drafts tab shows resume projects for company's jobs
Applications tab shows job application status timeline
Companies link appears in main navigation
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm exit code 0
